annotations.title: The connected person's answers to job application questions

description: For a connected person: their CURRENT answers to the questions employer application forms ask (contact details, work authorization, availability, pay rule, each job's dates, supervisor, may-we-contact and reason for leaving, education, references, and more), each with where it came from and how to enter it on a form. Use them word for word. Legal history, pay history, date of birth and licence numbers are never returned.

access_token.description: Not needed when the person signed in through your Connect / sign-in button (OAuth). Otherwise the access_token from finish_connecting.
